Antwerp: gold fell to €120.57 a gram and silver to €1,773.39 a kilogram, on the tape's verified close.

Kitco's spot is down 0.96% for gold and 3.31% for silver; the ECB's euro reference rate of 1.1592 set the board. Rapaport's polished benchmark held flat.

Antwerpen: goud daalde naar €120,57 per gram en zilver naar €1.773,39 per kilogram, op de geverifieerde slotkoers van de tape.
